German UI. Target 1920x1200 landscape, extraordinarily crisp typography, beautiful spacing, high contrast and realistic working software. Fill the canvas with UI, no physical laptop, no browser chrome, no perspective, no stock photos, no robots, no random charts. A discreet label 'ENTWURF · BEISPIELDATEN' always visible. Persistent six-item navigation: Übersicht, Agenten, Vorschläge, Läufe, Zusammenspiel, Einstellungen. LIEUVA brand top left; status 'Lokal verbunden'. Six specialist agents plus ONE Master (seven total); roles: Qualität & Risiken, UX, Produktstrategie, Markt, SEO / GEO, 3D & Blender. Jobs execute serially: maximum one active job, queued jobs explicitly distinct. No peer-to-peer agent chat. Approval and execution are SEPARATE explicit steps. Local completion is not publication. Show readable short meaningful German text rather than many illegible paragraphs. Use generous touch targets and consistent elegant thin outline icons. Preserve this concept's design language across all screens.

CONCEPT ORBIT: Premium DARK technical control-room UI, deep ink #090F1C canvas, layered blue-charcoal #121D2C surfaces, cool white #EAF2FB text, electric cyan #65D7EB primary, restrained periwinkle #9F9BEF secondary. Slim left rail expanded with labels and crisp slim topbar. Very subtle faint grid only behind network, 14px corners, razor-fine borders, precise spatial typography, clean data tables. Small luminous accents only at active selection and network paths. Futuristic but supremely readable, cinematic digital craft without sci-fi clutter. No purple gradient wallpaper, no giant glowing orbs, no holograms or floating screens.
